'''Nu'na''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At some point after [[3636 BBY]], Nu'na was recruited into the crew of [[Blizz]], one of the few Jawas who took to salvaging beyond the sands of Tatooine and into the wider galaxy. In [[3631 BBY]], the crew was working on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where they had a work assignment from [[Languss Tuno]]. [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] showed up to recruit Blizz and his crew to their cause and Blizz agreed on the condition that the stranger would help them complete their current job first. Nu'na received socks to help against the cold of Hoth and later joined the rest of the crew in the assault on the encampment of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], who held the box their client was after. After the box was retrieved and their job completed, Blizz accepted the new job and the entire crew traveled with him to [[Odessen]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nu'na appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Blizz Alliance alert mission. Unlike the other Jawas in the crew who are referred to with "he/him" or "she/her" pronouns via the "Jawa Crew" character effects during the Ugnaught assault, Nu'na's gender or pronouns are never specified.<ref name="SWTOR" />
